import con_mintorburn_gov as mobgov
import con_mintorburn as mob
owner = Variable()
active = Variable()

proposals = Hash(default_value=" ")

@construct
def seed():
    owner.set(ctx.caller)
    active.set(False)

def addProposal(id: int, title: str, description: str, enddate: datetime.datetime, metadata_entry: str, options: []):
    error = 'Only the current owner can add a proposal'
    assert owner.get() == ctx.caller, error
    proposals[id]["title"] = title
    proposals[id]["description"] = description
    proposals[id]["enddate"] = enddate
    proposals[id]["options"] = options
    proposals[id]["metadata_entry"] = metadata_entry
    proposals[id]["active"] = True
    proposals[id]["votes"] = []

def voteProposal(id: int, option: str, amount: float):
    error = 'You can only vote for active proposals'
    assert proposals[id]["active"] == True, error
    error = 'Proposal Voting has already ended'
    assert proposals[id]["enddate"] <= now, error
    mobgov.transfer_from(amount=amount, to=ctx.this, main_account=ctx.caller)
    proposals[id]["votes"][option][ctx.caller] += amount

def endProposal(id: int):
    error = 'Only the current owner can end a proposal'
    assert owner.get() == ctx.caller, error
    error = 'You can only end active proposals'
    assert proposals[id]["active"] == True, error
    end_amount_options_vote = {}
    for option in proposals[id]["options"]:
        for voter, amount in proposals[id]["votes"][option]:
            end_amount_options_vote[option] += amount
            mobgov.transfer(amount=amount, to=voter)
    winning_option = max(end_amount_options_vote, key=end_amount_options_vote.get)
    if(proposals[id]["metadata_entry"] != ""):
        mob.change_metadata(proposals[id]["metadata_entry"],winning_option)
    proposals[id]["active"] = False

@export
def setActive(state: bool):
    error = 'Only the current owner can set the state'
    assert owner.get() == ctx.caller, error
    active.set(state)

@export
def setOwner(address: str):
    error = 'Only the current owner can set a new owner'
    assert owner.get() == ctx.caller, error
    owner.set(address)
